expected_diagnosis: All inodes used despite available disk blocks.
recommended_next_checks: Find directories with many small files (cache/temp) safely.
resolution_guidance: Coordinate deletion/archiving of known temporary files.
verification: Inodes available and file creation works.
escalate_when: Unknown data owner or inode leak.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
